name: archome-ai
description: AI virtual staging and architectural rendering inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Archome AI turns photos, sketches and descriptions into photorealistic interior and architectural images, right inside ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Virtual staging: furnish an empty room photo, or replace the furniture that is already there, in a style you choose (Japandi, modern luxury, minimal, classic and more). The tool is designed to keep the walls, windows, floors and camera angle of your photo.
- Interior and exterior renders: restyle a room or a building from a photo or a 3D screenshot.
- Sketch to render: turn a hand sketch or line drawing into a realistic image of the project.
- Edits in plain language: "remove all furniture", "make the sky blue", "day to dusk", "brighter, warmer light".
- Upscale an image, create an image from a text description, and start a short video from a still.

How it works: connect your Archome account once (sign in and press Allow). Share a photo in the chat or a link and describe what you want. The result comes back in the conversation with a link to the full-resolution file, which is also saved to your Archome library. You can ask for your account status and the status of a render at any time.

Who it is for: real estate agents and photographers who need staged listing photos, architects and interior designers who want quick concept images, and homeowners planning a renovation.

AI-generated images are visualizations and may differ from the original in small details. Review results before using them in listings.
defaultPrompt: Stage this empty living room in a Japandi style
Replace the furniture in this bedroom with a modern minimal set
Turn this house photo into a twilight shot
